searchText: Noob question, why do we need 0x03 at all? 0x03 builder in the spec right now is just a validator, with the same staking requirement and same duty as regular validator. Why don't we allow non-0x03s to submit bids and build payloads too? Technically any non-0x03 can become 0x03 just subject to churn limit while waiting in the queue. Or the other way around, 0x03 without submitting bids is identical to 0x02 It's to protect staking pools. Node operators not necessarily control the withdrawal credentials So if they were allowed to build for others they could just simply steal the principal
